Lyrico (portable)
================

Run Lyrico.bat. A Java 21 or newer runtime must be installed (JAVA_HOME or PATH).

Layout:
  app\        the application and its dependencies
  native\     the native libraries (taglib, ebur128, quickjs-ng)
  ffmpeg\     the ffmpeg sidecar used for loudness analysis (LGPL v3; LICENSE.txt next to it)
  THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md
